children: MAZDA, KIA, AND BYD IMPROVE ACCESS TO SERVICE AND REPAIR INFORMATION AFTER ACCC INVESTIGATIONS
FOLLOWING ACCC’S INVESTIGATION, MAZDA AUSTRALIA PROVIDED COURT-ENFORCEABLE UNDERTAKING TO IMPROVE ITS MVIS COMPLIANCE
FOLLOWING ACCC’S INVESTIGATION KIA INTRODUCED PROGRAM FOR INDEPENDENT REPAIRERS TO ACCESS DIAGNOSTIC HARDWARE AND SOFTWARE FOR A$136 A DAY
BYD HAS ALSO INTRODUCED A DAILY ACCESS OPTION FOR A$140
